summary: Better as a Blitz than a classic daily: anyone with some football knowledge can rattle off 15+ Premier League scorers, but in classic the famous names outside the top 10 (Haaland, Ronaldo, Gerrard, Drogba) burn lives fast.
reasons: Kane, Rooney, Salah, Henry, Agüero and Lampard are known well beyond football fans; Andy Cole, Fowler and Defoe are not, so it is too niche for the main daily.
Blitz works well: 35 scoring answers, and most of the famous strikers a casual fan thinks of are in the pool.
Data is current and clean at the top; 'son' and 'heung min son' are not recognized for Son Heung-min (#17).
fixes: Add aliases 'Son', 'Heung-min Son', 'Son Heung Min' to Son Heung-min (#17); only 'Heung-min' works now.
Drop junk aliases: 'Elen Rivas' (Frank Lampard), 'Nicole Merry' (Thierry Henry), 'Tommy Rooney' (a different player, on Wayne Rooney), 'Sergioaguero.com' (Sergio Agüero).
